broll-stock-video.png.intent: An accepted stock clip drawn over the speaker. The dialogue is preserved, so the picture changes and the sound does not.

ken-burns.png.intent: A still given the drift a static frame otherwise lacks.

overlay-opacity.png.intent: An overlay blended over the picture at its own opacity.
